THE COMPLETE DOCTOR ACADEMYMRCPsych Paper B · Domain 13 Research Methods, Statistics and Critical Review

Aim and objectives

Aim. To prepare you to calculate and interpret prevalence, incidence, survival and mortality statistics for MRCPsych Paper B.

At the end of this chapter, you should be able to:

  1. Define incidence, point prevalence and period prevalence, and calculate each from a worked example.
  2. Apply the relationship prevalence approximately equals incidence multiplied by mean duration in a steady population.
  3. Explain censoring in time-to-event data and interpret a Kaplan-Meier curve, including median survival.
  4. Interpret a hazard ratio and name the log-rank test and Cox regression as methods for comparing survival.
  5. Calculate a crude death rate and a standardised mortality ratio, and compare direct and indirect standardisation.
  6. Answer the chapter's 81 exam-style questions, scoring at least 80%, by the end of this chapter.
